description: 👋 Welcome! This spacious 4-bedroom apartment is fully heated and located on the 1st floor of a very quiet residence.🤝 Perfect for families or groups, 2 bathrooms for extra privacy.🥐 Wake up to the smell of fresh croissants and live like a local! You’re right in the heart of a vibrant neighborhood, with charming bakeries, restaurants, and shops just outside your door.🚇 2-min walk to Arts et Métiers station (L3 & 11). 🏛️ Easy access: 15 min to the Louvre / 25 min to the Eiffel Tower.The space✨ Spacious 4BR Home – Prime Location & Modern Comfort (Sleeps 11)Experience Paris with all the comforts of home. This large, quiet 1st-floor apartment is designed for families, groups, or business travelers who value space and top-tier amenities.🛋️ Living & Tech- High-Speed Wi-Fi throughout (perfect for streaming or remote work).- Flat-screen TV and a spacious lounge for the whole group.- 🔥 High-performance heating system for a cozy winter stay.- one air conditioner in the living room🍽️ Fully Loaded Kitchen- Dishwasher (save time on chores!).- Full-size oven, microwave, and large fridge.- ☕ Coffee maker & Kettle provided for your morning routine.- 🍷 Large dining table that actually fits everyone.🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements- 👑 The Master Suite: Features a Queen-size bed, a dedicated workspace, and its own ensuite private bathroom.- 🛌 3 Additional Bedrooms: Including a family room with a double bed + single mezzanine (perfect for kids).- Fresh hotel-quality linens and comfortable bedding provided.🛁 Bathrooms & Laundry- 🚿 2 Full Bathrooms: No waiting in line! Includes 2 showers and 2 toilets.- High-pressure hair dryers and fresh towels included.🧺 Laundry: Access to washing facilities for long-stay convenience.📍 Location: 2 min to Metro (Arts et Métiers). Direct access to the Louvre and Shop

enrichment.summary: Four-bedroom, single-level apartment with at least three proper beds visible, including a raised mezzanine single that needs a ladder. The listing states two showers and two toilets and advertises AC; one guest says AC reaches only two rooms. Guests generally praise the location and quiet.

issues: A raised single mezzanine bed is visible with a ladder; the listing says the home is single-level, but access to that bed requires climbing.
One guest says the air conditioning is available in only two rooms.

themes: Several of the 10 reviews praise the central location, nearby transit and quiet setting.
Several guests describe the apartment as spacious and suitable for family groups, with responsive hosts.
concerns: One guest says air conditioning is available in only two rooms.
One guest notes the bunk/mezzanine bedroom opens off the living room and used a blackout shade for privacy.
